items.title: 8.4 Dynamic equilibrium between two physical states (do physical states ke darmiyan dynamic equilibrium) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.4, printed pages 170-171, with Quick Check 8.2 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Dynamic equilibrium reversible process ki woh halat hai jis mein ek taraf tabdeeli ki rate doosri (ulti) taraf tabdeeli ki rate ke barabar hoti hai. Yani tabdeeliyan lagataar ho rahi hain, lekin poore system mein koi net (kul) change nazar nahi aata. Jab kisi substance ki reversible phase change (halat ki tabdeeli) ho to do physical states ke darmiyan bhi dynamic equilibrium hota hai. Example: 0 °C par barf aur pani saath saath equilibrium mein rehte hain. Pani barf banta hai aur barf wapas pani banti hai, dono ek hi rate se.
